cases.description: Three final versions of one artifact, given out of order. An item is accepted and changed, then superseded. An item is added and then dropped. A question is rejected and stays in the record.
A second team starts a new artifact with the first artifact as an input parent. A decision of the new artifact supersedes a decision of the first one, and a requirement is derived from another one.
Versions 1 and 3 of an artifact, without version 2. The history gives one warning and compares version 3 with version 1.
